messages:
Maya: quick heads-up — I opened a small PR to consolidate the SDK snippets for streaming + pagination across Python/TypeScript/Go. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3421
Kevin: nice, will review after stand. does this break any older examples?
Maya: no breaking changes — left the legacy examples but added a recommended pattern section. the new py example uses an async generator for cursored streaming, the ts one uses a ReadableStream pattern with backpressure notes, go uses a channel-based iterator with a retry helper.
Lee: can you paste the minimal py snippet here? want to sanity-check syntax for the docs runner.
Maya: sure —
Maya: ```py
async def stream_responses(prompt):
    async for chunk in client.chat.stream(model="rwd/stream-lite", messages=[{"role":"user","content":prompt}]):
        yield chunk.text
```
Kevin: looks good. add a short note about REDWOOD_API_KEY env var naming (some older examples used API_KEY).
Maya: added that note to the PR description and the migration guide.
Lee: FYI the docs build was failing on fenced block language tags (we had ```js vs ```javascript), I fixed the tags in the branch so highlighting matches.
PR-bot: added labels: docs, snippets, needs-review; linked CI -> https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/3421/checks
Docs Bot: preview deployed at https://deploy-preview-3421--docs.redwood.ai/ — looks like the streaming snippet renders in the left rail correctly.
Henry: I can run the go example on linux/amd64 and check for compile warnings later today.
Kevin: please add a one-line explainer about tokenization differences when streaming tokens vs whole-chunk outputs — saw a customer confusion thread earlier.
Maya: done — added a short note and example comparing token vs text streaming with model examples.
Lee: small nit: the TS example should show how to abort the ReadableStream with a signal (Fetch AbortController). might save devs a headache.
Maya: good catch — added abort example and a tiny retry backoff helper in TS.
Kevin: :eyes: will take a final pass, but this is looking clean. can someone else approve so we can merge during the afternoon window?
Henry: happy to approve after I run the go snippet.
Maya: awesome — ping me when you approve. planning to merge after CI passes. :thumbsup:
Maya: also added a short changelog entry under docs/updates for visibility.
Kevin: thanks — once merged we should push a slack note for users about the recommended patterns.
Maya: will do.
